translations.translatedText: # Tuesday 2.8.2022
Finns' worries. Customers of Lumo Energia. The leader of al-Qaeda. The weather.
TV's Clear News has a summer break 6.6.–12.8.
Read and listen to the radio broadcast here.
## Finns' worries

![There is a large hole in the apartment block. In the foreground a blue-yellow Ukrainian flag is fluttering.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3840,h_2160,x_0,y_240/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-96975962a859a361f90/1655200714)
Open image viewer
Finns are worried about the war. Peace is an important thing for Finns. Photo: Genya Savilov / AFP
The big worry of Finns is the war. About 50 percent of Finns are very worried about the war and the threat of war. This is what Yle's survey says.
The war has become a big worry for Finns since Russia attacked Ukraine. Russia's war in Ukraine began in February of this year.
When a similar survey was last done 2 years ago, only 10 percent of Finns were very worried about the war.
Then Finns were more worried about climate change, for example. Now the worry about climate change has decreased.
The survey also tells which things are important to Finns. They are peace, freedom and health.
## Customers of Lumo Energia

![Adjustment knob of a heating radiator in a house heated by electricity.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4989,h_2806,x_0,y_527/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-98161062cec5fb6cc62/1664200959)
Open image viewer
Some of Lumo's customers have to look for a new electricity seller. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
Customers of the electricity seller Lumo Energia have received new information. Lumo Energia says that some of its customers must look for a new electricity seller for themselves.
About 4000 Lumo customers need a new electricity seller. Later they will be without electricity, if they do not themselves make an electricity contract with another electricity seller.
The reason is that Lumo Energia is ending its business. Lumo tried to find a new electricity seller for all customers, but it did not succeed.
Lumo decided to end its business, because the situation in the electricity market is difficult.
## The leader of al-Qaeda
![Osama bin Laden and Ayman al-Zawahiri](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9569820)
Open image viewer
The leaders of al-Qaeda Osama bin Laden and Ayman al-Zawahiri. Photo: Ausaf newspaper/EPA
The leader of the terrorist organisation al-Qaeda has died. The leader of al-Qaeda, Ayman al-Zawahiri, died in a US airstrike.
The USA carried out an airstrike at the weekend in the capital of Afghanistan, Kabul. President Joe Biden says that the strike was made against terrorism.
Ayman al-Zawahiri became the leader of al-Qaeda after Osama bin Laden in 2011. Al-Zawahiri was one of the planners of the New York terror attack.
Al-Qaeda carried out a terror attack on the World Trade Center in New York on 11 September 2001. About 3000 people died in the attack.
## The weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12560569)
Open image viewer
On Wednesday the weather turns dry and the rain stops. However, in a large part of the country it is cloudy.
In cloudy areas the temperature stays under 20 degrees. In the south, however, the sun may shine on Wednesday and the temperature may rise over 20 degrees.
On Thursday the weather warms up. In the south there may even be a heatwave, that is, the temperature may be over 25 degrees. Rain and thunder showers become more common on Thursday.
